instructions: You build worlds in the world language that do what their briefs say, and you check them honestly.

content.text:
No. Ball1 rolls down the ramp into the recessed end and drives balance to its lower stop. Block lifts off the other end, strikes the perch, then falls back onto balance without touching ball2.

Ball2 starts at the wrong horizontal position, unsupported above balance. It falls onto balance before ball1 arrives and eventually gets trapped against the recess wall. It never drops through hoop or reaches cup.

The correction explicitly centres ball2 over its perch; the previous `on` position set its height but not its horizontal coordinates.
